Over the past 30 years, we have built our reputation on providing exceptional service and remaining focused on building long term, value driven relationships with our clients.

As an Australian owned and operated company, we take pride in doing “whatever it takes” to deliver for our clients, and be a valued and respected part of the communities in which we live and operate. We are immensely proud of the investment we make in apprentices, trainees, and local suppliers.

About the Role
By joining our team, you will have the opportunity to be a part of a workforce that is focused on developing a strong performance culture and a culture that values everyone’s contribution equally.

The role includes but is not limited to:
Read and interpret project plans, engineering drawings, blueprints and other written instructions and diagrams to perform task at hand

Trade certificate in Engineering Fabrication or Equivalent

Summary: 
Join an organisation that is shaping the future direction of software engineering in Australia, in an academic role that combines high-quality research, excellent teaching, and meaningful contribution to the School’s strategic priorities.

Job Details
•	Salary, 
o	Lecturer (Level B) – AUD $127,947 to $150,830 per annum + 17% superannuation
o	Senior Lecturer (Level C) – AUD $155,403 to $178,290 per annum + 17% superannuation
•	Full-time
•	2-Year Convertible Tenure Track or continuing appointment
•	Location: Kensington – Sydney, Australia

The Opportunity
Join the School of Computer Science and Engineering in the Faculty of Engineering at UNSW as a Lecturer / Senior Lecturer in a Teaching and Research role. In this role, you will contribute to the advancement of research and education in modern computing systems, while helping to shape the next generation of computing professionals.

You will conduct research in areas including AI for Software Engineering, Software Engineering for AI, AI Application Engineering, Software Development Lifecycle and Software Architectures. Through your research, you will contribute to high-impact scholarly outcomes, collaborative research initiatives and the School's growing international reputation in Software Engineering.

With established strengths across Software Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Cybersecurity and Computer Systems, UNSW offers an exceptional environment for academics seeking to build their research profile, contribute to interdisciplinary collaboration and deliver outstanding teaching. This is an opportunity to join one of Australia's leading Computer Science and Engineering schools, supported by world-class facilities, strong industry partnerships and a culture of innovation and impact.

This is an opportunity to join a global leader in Computer Science, with cutting-edge facilities, world-class faculty, and an innovative research environment. With strong industry partnerships and a commitment to sustainability, UNSW provides excellent opportunities for career development, collaboration, and impact.

About You
You are an emerging or established academic with expertise in Software Engineering and a passion for both research and teaching. You will have the ability to contribute to high-quality research outcomes while delivering engaging and innovative learning experiences for undergraduate and postgraduate students.

At Lecturer level (Level B), you will be developing your research profile and contributing to collaborative research activities, including competitive grant applications and scholarly publications, while also delivering high-quality teaching and supporting student learning across undergraduate and postgraduate courses.

At Senior Lecturer level (Level C), you will demonstrate an established research track record with evidence of research leadership, success in securing competitive funding, supervising HDR students, and making significant independent contributions to your field. You will also contribute to educational leadership through high-quality teaching, curriculum development, and mentoring students and colleagues.

You are an engaging educator with experience in delivering high-quality teaching and contributing to curriculum development. You are collaborative, adaptable, and motivated to contribute to a high-performing academic environment and to build strong relationships across academia and industry.

About UNSW
UNSW is a world leading institution recognised for its scale, prestige, and impact. With strong industry engagement and partnerships across sectors, UNSW provides a unique environment where academic expertise translates into real world outcomes. The university is home to cutting edge research that drives innovation and societal progress, while its excellence in teaching ensures students are prepared to lead in their fields. For academics, UNSW offers an outstanding platform to flourish — combining world class facilities, collaborative networks, and a culture of innovation that supports both career growth and meaningful contributions to the wider community.

The School of Computer Science and Engineering is one of the largest and most prestigious schools of computing in Australia. It offers undergraduate programmes in Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, and Bioinformatics, as well as a number of combined degrees with other disciplines. Our research and teaching staff are world leading and world building as they advance knowledge and learning. For more information on our school, please visit: https://www.unsw.edu.au/engineering/our-schools/computer-science-and-engineering 

Skills & Experience:
Lecturer (Level B)
•	A PhD in a related discipline, and/or relevant work experience.
•	Proven commitment to proactively keeping up to date with discipline knowledge and developments.
•	Demonstrated experience in teaching and learning design, development and delivery at undergraduate and/or postgraduate level.
•	Experience using and/or designing with educational technologies and online delivery methods.
•	Evidence of teaching effectiveness and passion for educational excellence (e.g. relevant discipline-based curriculum design and development at a variety of levels and scales).
•	Demonstrated knowledge of industry or experience of work-integrated learning (desirable). 
•	Evidence of ability to support and inspire students from diverse backgrounds and support student equity, diversity and inclusion initiatives.

Senior Lecturer (Level C)
•	A PhD in a related discipline, and/or relevant work experience.
•	Proven commitment to proactively keeping up to date with discipline knowledge and developments.
•	Demonstrated experience in teaching and learning design using a range of pedagogical approaches, development and delivery of courses and programs, at undergraduate and/or postgraduate level. 
•	Experience of implementing educational technologies and online delivery methods.
•	Evidence of teaching effectiveness and passion for educational excellence and fostering this in others.
•	Demonstrated success in initiating curriculum development and improvement. 
•	Demonstrated experience with industry or work-integrated learning. 
•	Evidence of ability to support and inspire students from diverse backgrounds and support student equity diversity and inclusion initiatives.
•	Demonstrated track record in research with outcomes of high quality and high impact with clear evidence of the desire and ability to continually achieve research excellence as well as the capacity for research leadership.
•	Experience in successfully recruiting and supervising high calibre students.
•	Demonstrated ability to work in a team, collaborate across disciplines and build effective relationships.
•	Evidence of highly developed interpersonal and organisational skills.
•	Demonstrated ability to interact with the profession and industry and attract funding for learning and teaching initiatives.
•	An understanding of and commitment to UNSW’s aims, objectives and values in action, together with relevant policies and guidelines.
•	Knowledge of health and safety responsibilities and commitment to attending relevant health and safety training.

Additional details about the specific responsibilities for this position can be found in the position description. This is available via JOBS@UNSW. 

To Apply: 
If you are an emerging academic looking to build your research and teaching profile, or an established academic seeking to further your career, this opportunity offers the chance to contribute to high-quality research, deliver engaging teaching, and help shape the future direction of the School. We encourage you to click the “Apply Now” button and submit your CV, cover letter, and responses addressing the Skills and Experience criteria.

If this opportunity interests you, but your experience does not align perfectly with every selection criterion, we still encourage you to apply.

Maintenance Planner position available in all states NSW, Qld, Vic, & WA

At NEPEAN™ we are proud to be Australia’s leading privately owned engineering, mining services and industrial manufacturing organisation. We have unique capabilities to deliver high value, innovative and sustainable solutions for the world’s leading mining, construction, and transport companies. Over the last 40 years, hard work, technical credibility, and a willingness to tackle very difficult projects have earned NEPEAN an enviable reputation. Today our organisation employs over 1400 people across six continents and distributes products to more than 65 countries.

We service our customers in all states of Australia through multiple businesses in our portfolio: NEPEAN Building and Infrastructure (Galserv, Galintel, Weldlok), NEPEAN Engineering and Innovation, NEPEAN Power, Mining (NEPEAN Longwall), PROK, NEPEAN Conveyors, NEPEAN Transport, Gurtec, Roxon, and NEPEAN Belting Mackay with business locations in Queensland, New South Wales and Western Australia.

Our Opportunity
We are looking for an experienced Maintenance Planner to join our team, bringing a goal-oriented mindset to ensure minimal disruption to the organisation's assets and projects. This role aims to achieve planned time, cost, and quality metrics for projects, aligning with NEPEAN Conveyor’s policies and procedures. The Maintenance Planner will be responsible for strategising, scheduling, coordinating, and monitoring the maintenance of all plant equipment, infrastructure, and machinery - minimizing downtime, reducing costs, and improving overall operational efficiency

Core responsibilities include however are not limited to:
Planning and Scheduling: Develop and manage detailed maintenance schedules and work orders to ensure timely and cost-efficient maintenance of the organisation’s activities and goals.
Coordination: Work closely with maintenance personnel, engineering teams, and operations to schedule regular preventive maintenance, handle emergencies, and conduct inspections. Ensuring minimal disruption to production or services.
Safety Compliance: Ensure that all maintenance work complies with safety regulations and industry standards.
Record Keeping: Maintain accurate records of maintenance performed, equipment condition, and maintenance costs.
Equipment Modifications: Plan and implement equipment modifications and upgrades in collaboration with engineering and operations teams.
Inventory Management: Track the inventory of spare parts and ensure their availability for routine and emergency maintenance.
Problem-Solving: Identify and address potential issues before they become costly problems, and adjust schedules to account for unexpected emergency work.
Reporting: Prepare and present reports on maintenance activities and their effectiveness.

The Right Person
We are interested in hearing from you if you have:
A degree or certificate in a related field such as engineering, industrial maintenance, or facilities management.
Prior experience in facilities maintenance, industrial maintenance, or a similar field.
Strong understanding of maintenance procedures, best practices, and equipment.
Excellent organisational and planning skills to manage schedules and coordinate maintenance activities.
Strong verbal and written communication skills to effectively collaborate with maintenance personnel, and engineering teams.
Ability to identify and address potential issues proactively.
Familiarity with maintenance management software and other relevant tools.
Knowledge of safety regulations and protocols to ensure compliance during maintenance activities.
Meticulous attention to detail for accurate record-keeping and reporting.

NEPEAN believes in diversity and is committed to providing Equal Employment opportunities for all applicants. We welcome applicants from all walks of life, including various socio-economic, cultural, LGBTIQ, Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander backgrounds

If you're ready for your next challenge, please "Apply Now" and forward through your interest today!
Salary: $130,000 per annum

result.description: A & M Packaging Pty Ltd  A & M Packaging Pty Limited is a leading Australian provider of flexible packaging solutions, committed to quality, innovation, and operational excellence. We provide comprehensive services ranging from packaging design and lamination to conversion and distribution. We are currently seeking a highly skilled Quality Engineering Officer to join our team and drive technical optimization across our manufacturing operations.  The Quality Engineering Officer will play a critical role in optimizing our packaging production lines and manufacturing technologies. You will be responsible for analysing system performance, implementing process improvements, and ensuring that our manufacturing workflows operate at peak efficiency, quality, and compliance. This role bridges the gap between production and engineering, requiring a hands-on approach to technical troubleshooting, equipment validation, and data-driven continuous improvement.   Benefits   Task & responsibilities   Evaluate manufacturing lines and equipment performance to pinpoint opportunities for increasing productivity, efficiency, and product quality.  Conduct root cause analysis on equipment failures and process anomalies, implementing engineering-based solutions to restore and enhance operational reliability.  Formulate and execute process improvement strategies aimed at maximizing resource utilization and reducing operational waste.  Assess production methods against established technical specifications and engineering standards to ensure all manufacturing processes remain within defined parameters.  Provide hands-on technical guidance and troubleshooting for production machinery and process technologies to mitigate downtime and boost system output.  Design, refine, and enforce technical documentation, standard operating procedures, and process controls to maintain consistency in production outcomes.  Partner with production, quality, and engineering teams to streamline packaging systems and refine manufacturing workflows.  Participate in the commissioning, testing, and validation of new manufacturing assets to ensure they meet performance and engineering benchmarks.  Develop and oversee testing and inspection protocols to verify process capability and maintain rigorous product performance standards.  Analyse production metrics and performance data to identify operational trends, supporting the implementation of continuous improvement projects.  Assist in the maintenance of operational and quality management frameworks to ensure alignment with industry regulations and internal business requirements.  Track the success of corrective and preventive actions (CAPA), evaluating the impact of implemented solutions and recommending further technical upgrades where needed.    Qualification & experience   A tertiary qualification (Bachelor’s degree or Higher) in Engineering, Engineering Technology, or a related technical discipline.  Proven professional experience in a manufacturing, packaging, or industrial processing environment.  At least 3 years of professional experience in a similar role.  Solid understanding of engineering principles, production workflows, and manufacturing process controls.  Proficiency in utilising ERP systems (e.g., SAP or Microsoft Dynamics 365) for production data analysis and operational monitoring.  Demonstrated ability to conduct root cause analysis, troubleshoot equipment issues, and implement effective engineering solutions.  Excellent communication skills, with the ability to provide technical guidance and collaborate effectively across cross-functional teams.   About Company    A & M Packaging Pty Limited is a leading Australian manufacturer and supplier of flexible packaging solutions, specializing in high-performance lamination, conversion, and distribution services across the country. We partner with a diverse range of industries to deliver consistently high standards of manufacturing quality, technical precision, and operational efficiency.  With a strong commitment to engineering excellence and service, we provide tailored packaging solutions designed to meet the complex technical requirements of each client. Our business places significant emphasis on process innovation, workplace safety, and continuous improvement to ensure our production systems are highly efficient, reliable, and performance-driven.  At A & M Packaging, our team members are dedicated professionals who take pride in their technical expertise and contribute directly to the innovation and operational success of our manufacturing operations. result.description:
Target Business Services
Location: 22 Lara Way, Campbellfield VIC 3061
Salary: $80,000 plus 12% superannuation
Position: Full time, permanent

Build Tiny Pty Ltd is an innovative Australian manufacturer specialising in the design and construction of premium tiny homes and modular living solutions. Operating from its Campbellfield, VIC manufacturing facility, the company combines skilled craftsmanship, precision engineering and modern construction techniques to deliver high-quality, durable and sustainable homes for customers throughout Australia. 

Due to continued business growth, Build Tiny Pty Ltd is seeking an experienced and trade-qualified Welder (First Class) to join its production team.

Working within a modern manufacturing environment, you will fabricate and weld structural steel and metal components used in the construction of custom-built tiny homes. The successful applicant will be capable of working from engineering drawings, maintaining high quality standards and contributing to efficient production schedules.
This is a full-time position offering long-term career opportunities within a growing Australian manufacturer.

Minimum Requirements

-	Certificate III in Engineering – Fabrication Trade (or equivalent qualification) 
-	Minimum one-year relevant post-qualification experience as a Welder (First Class) 
-	Demonstrated experience in MIG and TIG welding and general steel fabrication 
-	Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings and fabrication plans 
-	Strong understanding of fabrication tolerances and quality control procedures 
-	Commitment to workplace health and safety 

Key Responsibilities

-	Perform high-quality MIG, TIG and other welding processes on structural steel, stainless steel and aluminium components used in tiny home construction. 
-	Fabricate, assemble and weld chassis, structural frames, brackets and other metal components in accordance with engineering drawings and production specifications. 
-	Read and interpret technical drawings, welding symbols and fabrication documentation. 
-	Prepare materials by cutting, grinding, drilling, milling, tapping and shaping steel components prior to fabrication. 
-	Measure, mark and accurately align components using precision measuring equipment. 
-	Inspect welds to ensure structural integrity, penetration, dimensional accuracy and compliance with quality standards. 
-	Complete finishing work including grinding, dressing, polishing and deburring fabricated components. 
-	Assist in fitting fabricated steel assemblies into modular building frames where required. 
-	Operate welding and fabrication equipment safely and efficiently while ensuring machinery is maintained in good working condition. 
-	Identify fabrication issues and work collaboratively with supervisors and production staff to achieve practical manufacturing solutions. 
-	Maintain welding procedure specifications, quality assurance documentation and production records. 
-	Ensure compliance with workplace health, safety and environmental procedures. 
-	Contribute to achieving daily production targets while maintaining high standards of workmanship. 

To be successful you will possess

-	Demonstrated structural steel fabrication and welding experience within a manufacturing or engineering environment. 
-	Excellent fabrication, welding and metal finishing skills. 
-	Good mechanical aptitude and problem-solving skills. 
-	Ability to prioritise work and consistently meet production deadlines. 
-	Sound understanding of Australian workplace health and safety requirements. 
-	Physical fitness suitable for a manufacturing environment involving manual handling and standing for extended periods. 

If you meet the above criteria and are looking to join an innovative and growing Australian manufacturer, we would like to hear from you.

Please send your application to recruitment@targetbusiness.com.au
Please note that only shortlisted applicants will be contacted. All applications will be treated with strict confidentiality.

result.description:
Since 1981, Shadbolt Group has grown to become a leading cost-effective engineering solutions provider. We are proud of our professional performance on each and every project. Our aim is to build long term relationships with our clients based on trust, accountability and integrity. It is our dedication to quality that gives our clients a competitive advantage.

This goes hand in hand with our diligence and engineering excellence. From pipework projects to tank manufacturing, structural works, machine building or site work. Shadbolt Group is committed to providing prompt and precise delivery from our highly trained team of experts. The requirements of each client are always the focus of everything we do.

We are seeking qualified Welders to join our growing professional team. We seek reliable, team-oriented individuals with high integrity who will positively contribute to the company's success. We offer short-term contracts with above-award pay rates fully guaranteed under current workplace regulations.
Position available across our site and work locations in NSW, SA, WA and VIC.

The role includes but is not limited to:
Read and interpret project plans, engineering drawings, blueprints and other written instructions and diagrams to perform task at hand
Perform fabrication and repair works on various metal structures and components according to engineering drawings, specifications, and blueprints
Work with variety of materials, including steel, aluminium, and other alloys
Weld small and large components such as copper plumbing, beams, and pipelines
Perform appropriate type of weld - base on project needs and specifications
Weld components in flat, vertical, and overhead positions
Ensure fabrication and repairs are carried out using the proper safety guidelines to ensure rework jobs do not occur
Use a range of hand and power tools, including grinders, drills, and cutting tools
Conduct quality checks on completed work to ensure it meets standard specifications
Monitor machinery for appropriate usage and temperature
Follow and enforce strict safety regulations such as wearing heat-resistant gloves, protective masks, and safety shoes to prevent accidents and injuries in the workplace

To be considered for this role, you must have the following:
Trade certificate in Engineering Fabrication or Equivalent
Proficient in performing all welding, gouging, cutting or other duties
Post trade experience in the same field
Proactive attitude with the desire to work reliably as part of an outstanding team to deliver excellence for our clients
Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, specifications, and blueprints
Experience working with a variety of materials, including steel, aluminum, and other alloys
Familiarity with a range of hand and power tools, including grinders, drills, and cutting tools
Strong attention to detail and the ability to conduct quality checks on completed work
Ability to work independently or as part of a team to complete assigned tasks
Knowledge of safety procedures and regulations to prevent accidents and injuries in the workplace
Strong communication and reporting skills
Self-motivated, organised, punctual and reliable
Must have great work ethics

If you meet the above criteria and would like to be considered for this position, please apply now!

Salary: $49.00/hour, 38 hours per week + Super
